svg.title: Magnetoelastic Voigt Strain Modes and Bidirectional Magnon-Phonon Coupling
svg.desc: Two-panel scientific figure showing (a) normal (B_1) and shear (B_2) deformed cubic unit cells, the 6-component engineering-Voigt vector with gamma_ij = 2 epsilon_ij, and cubic magnetoelastic energy/field laws, and (b) bidirectional magnon-phonon coupling between LLG magnetization m (driven by H_mel + H_rot) and elastodynamic displacement u (driven by back-action stresses sigma^me + sigma^rot).

tspan.font-family: 'STIX Two Math', 'Cambria Math', 'Times New Roman', Georgia, serif

text.tspan: εeng = (ε11, ε22, ε33, γ23, γ13, γ12)T, γij = 2εij
